art_direction: 横置水滴眼内侧圆、外侧短收，双瞳轻向右，留白像折纸小片。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw two sideways teardrop openings, rounded toward the inner gap and narrowing briefly outside. A broad marker stroke carries each upper edge into its large pupil. Direct both pupils slightly right, with broad folded-paper-shaped gaps interrupting the black. Keep one lower edge fuller and the other a shorter curved mark. The flat iris patches sit toward the opposite side of the gaze. Allow small differences in stroke pressure while keeping the pair balanced. Eyes only on blank paper.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
